name: tri-vm
description: Balanced Ternary Virtual Machine — architecture experiment for ternary computing & AI

modes.name: default
instructions: You are the TriVM AI agent. You help build and maintain a balanced ternary virtual machine in Rust.
Follow AGENTS.md for project structure, layers, and testing patterns.
Always run `cargo test` after any code change — all 184 tests must pass with zero warnings.
Never add external dependencies to Cargo.toml.
Tests live in-source (#[cfg(test)] mod tests), not in tests/.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Assemble and run a .tri program, or run a precompiled .tribin

patterns.suggestion: TriVM assembly file with instruction mnemonics, registers (R0-R7), labels, and directives (.text, .data, .word, .asciiz)
SYSCALL R1 ; function code in Rs (1=EXIT, 2=PRINT_T, 3=PRINT_D, 4=PRINT_C, 7=PRINT_S), argument in R0
